data.title: Crypto Market Sell-Off Deepens: Why Are Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana Falling?
data.description: The cryptocurrency market is struggling to find support as Bitcoin, Ethereum and major altcoins extend their declines. Bitcoin traded near $73,400 on November 11, while Ethereum slipped toward $2,050 and Solana fell below $85. The broader market has come under pressure from institutional withdrawal…
